summary: Backend-only regression on the USER-LEVEL MCP proxy /api/mcp/{user_token}/api/... focusing on the deleted-active-canvas edge case. 10/10 pytest cases pass in /app/tests/test_user_mcp_deleted_canvas.py covering: happy path (mcp-token issue + create canvas + draw element -> success:true), the main edge case (delete canvas then draw/get elements/get scene/batch-create -> all return HTTP 404 with actionable detail mentioning 'not found' / 'may have been deleted' and suggesting list_canvases/set_active_canvas/create_canvas — no hang, <3s), ownership enforcement (user A drawing on user B's owned canvas -> 403 'You do not own this canvas'), missing/'default' canvasId -> 400 'No active canvas ... create_canvas or set_active_canvas', invalid mcp token -> 401, and post-delete responsiveness regression (delete then create-new + draw still succeeds).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py user_mcp_proxy() correctly distinguishes 404 (deleted/nonexistent) from 403 (exists-but-not-owned) with an actionable detail message — matches the fix intent.
The 400 message for missing canvasId also carries a recovery hint (create_canvas / set_active_canvas). Good.

Minor: DELETE branch for canvases/{id} calls http.delete on engine inside a bare try/except that swallows all exceptions. That's fine for resilience but a WARN log would help debugging engine outages.
Minor (carried from iter_1): persist_project_scene fired via asyncio.create_task without tracking — under bursty writes tasks can accumulate. Consider debouncing per project_id.
test_credentials: user_testabc123 / Bearer test_session_token_123 (auto-provisions mcp_token via GET /api/auth/mcp-token). user_testother456 / Bearer test_session_token_other_456 (same).
seed_data_creation: Ensured both users + sessions exist in test_database (idempotent mongosh upsert). Each test cleans up its own canvases via DELETE /api/mcp/{token}/api/canvases/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The deleted-active-canvas fix is verified across all four affected verbs: POST /api/elements, POST /api/elements/batch, GET /api/elements, GET /api/scene — all return 404 with the actionable message once the underlying project is deleted. Ownership branch (403) is exercised by a separate B-owned canvas. Existing /app/tests/test_gateway.py (project-level /api/engine/{agent_token} regression, 16/16) is untouched and still valid to run alongside this file.
